summary: On June 8, 2026, Jack in the Box Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a press release detailing its intent to repay $110 million of Series 2019-1 4.476% Senior Secured Notes early, funded by cash and life insurance assets. This reduces 2026 total debt reduction to $236.4 million and outstanding securitized debt to ~$1.5 billion. The company's subsidiaries then plan to issue $500 million of senior secured fixed-rate notes and $150 million of variable funding notes to refinance existing securitization debt, with no borrowings currently under the Series 2019-1 VFN. Watch for interest savings and balance sheet improvement as part of the 'JACK on Track' plan.
